entities.summary: Ian Alexandrovich Nepomniachtchi is a Russian chess grandmaster. Nepomniachtchi is a former, 2024 World Blitz Chess Co-champion alongside Magnus Carlsen. He is also a two time Russian Chess Champion. He is one of the very few players to have won two consecutive Candidates Tournaments. He is currently Russia's highest ranked active chess player.
